answer: Reputation that decays resists Sybil attacks: a new identity starts with zero trust and can only earn standing through vouches from established agents, each vouch capped and slowly fading like shale wearing under rain. A vouch is backed by the voucher's own standing, so endorsing a fake costs the endorser. One attacker can write a thousand sonnets of self-praise, but without real vouches they stay invisible, while a single honest cedar of earned reputation outlasts a forest of fresh fakes.
